appearance_facts.fact: The pale-yellow slice labeled 'Nuclear (45%)' is the largest wedge, extending from the 12 o'clock position to roughly the 8 o'clock position.
The orange-red slice labeled 'Hydroelectric (10%)' is the smallest wedge, extending from the 12 o'clock position to roughly the 4 o'clock position.
The dark-red slice labeled 'Fossil Fuels (30%)' is the second-largest wedge, extending from roughly the 8 o'clock position to the 6 o'clock position.
The light-orange slice labeled 'Renewables (15%)' is the third-largest wedge, extending from roughly the 6 o'clock position to the 4 o'clock position.

public_definitions: User goal: 'Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.'
Routing criterion: 'Largest global energy consumption category'
Option: 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring'
Option: 'Route Hydroelectric to priority source monitoring'
Option: 'Keep Fossil Fuels on routine source monitoring'
